Artificial Intelligence
What is Artificial Intelligence (AI) ? Artificial Intelligence (AI) is technology that enables machines and software to learn, think, analyze, and make decisions like humans.
AI helps people understand information, generate ideas, automate routine work, and make everyday tasks easier.
Instead of replacing people, AI helps us become more productive.
